response.original_title: 1860 — Discover Meise, where the grass is greener
response.overview: A northward stone’s throw from Brussels lies the municipality of Meise (postalcode: 1860). What wonders are there to behold? Discover this beautiful municipality — with all its villages, hamlets, parishes and hidden gems — in this informative, playful, and above all impeccably objective film.
